body:
Hi! Thanks for reporting. When doing a DNS query from the newTrackon server, I just get a CNAME record to `buyvm.ghostchu-services.top` which is not followed:
```
dig -t TXT trunker.ghostchu-services.top

; <<>> DiG 9.18.30-0ubuntu0.24.04.2-Ubuntu <<>> -t TXT trunker.ghostchu-services.top
;; global options: +cmd
;; Got answer:
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: NOERROR, id: 61844
;; flags: qr rd ra; QUERY: 1, ANSWER: 1, AUTHORITY: 1, ADDITIONAL: 1

;; OPT PSEUDOSECTION:
; EDNS: version: 0, flags:; udp: 65494
;; QUESTION SECTION:
;trunker.ghostchu-services.top. IN      TXT

;; ANSWER SECTION:
trunker.ghostchu-services.top. 300 IN   CNAME   buyvm.ghostchu-services.top.

;; AUTHORITY SECTION:
ghostchu-services.top.  1480    IN      SOA     alex.ns.cloudflare.com. dns.cloudflare.com. 2367266791 10000 2400 604800 1800

;; Query time: 70 msec
;; SERVER: 127.0.0.53#53(127.0.0.53) (UDP)
;; WHEN: Thu Mar 13 16:09:34 CET 2025
;; MSG SIZE  rcvd: 140
```
but when doing this query from anywhere else, I can see the TXT record:
```
dig -t TXT trunker.ghostchu-services.top

; <<>> DiG 9.18.30-0ubuntu0.24.04.2-Ubuntu <<>> -t TXT trunker.ghostchu-services.top
;; global options: +cmd
;; Got answer:
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: NOERROR, id: 55076
;; flags: qr rd ra; QUERY: 1, ANSWER: 1, AUTHORITY: 0, ADDITIONAL: 1

;; OPT PSEUDOSECTION:
; EDNS: version: 0, flags:; udp: 65494
;; QUESTION SECTION:
;trunker.ghostchu-services.top. IN      TXT

;; ANSWER SECTION:
trunker.ghostchu-services.top. 300 IN   TXT     "BITTORRENT DENY ALL"

;; Query time: 27 msec
;; SERVER: 127.0.0.53#53(127.0.0.53) (UDP)
;; WHEN: Thu Mar 13 15:10:47 UTC 2025
;; MSG SIZE  rcvd: 90
```

Are you intentionally exposing different DNS records to specific DNS resolvers?

> Are you intentionally exposing different DNS records to specific DNS resolvers?

Nope, I just added it in CloudFlare and I believe "exposing different DNS records to specific DNS resolvers" is not a feature in CloudFlare Free plan so No.

I reproduced this issue on my netcup server, the netcup's dns server seems ignored TXT records.  
But if I specify another reputable DNS server, it works fine.

newTrackon is hosted in Hetzner and uses the internal Hetzner DNS resolvers. It seems the Hetzner DNS resolvers don't follow the CNAME as they should, so I'll change them in a few minutes to the Google DNS resolvers.

Ok I've change the DNS resolvers, and newTrackon just removed the tracker:
```
2025-03-13 17:24:31,136 [INFO] [newtrackon] Updating https://trunker.ghostchu-services.top:443/announce
2025-03-13 17:24:31,144 [INFO] [newtrackon] Hostname denies connection via BEP34, removing tracker https://trunker.ghostchu-services.top:443/announce
2025-03-13 17:24:31,144 [INFO] [newtrackon] Removing https://trunker.ghostchu-services.top:443/announce
```

However, I believe you're not in compliance of the RFC. If a domain has a CNAME, it should not have any TXT records.

See https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc1034#section-3.6.2

> If a CNAME RR is present at a node, no other data should be
present; this ensures that the data for a canonical name and its aliases
cannot be different.

See also https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2181#section-10.1
